shared_elements: low-relief carved motifs on stone surface
circular or ring motif (rings on the back vs. wheel discs)
horizontal banded elements (belt-like bands vs. register lines)
justification: Both surfaces depict human-derived forms and incidental circular/ring motifs with horizontal banding, but these are the most generic possible correspondences. A is a single monumental three-dimensional anthropomorphic figure with a few large abstract symbols (rings, arcs, a belt) on its back, while B is a multi-register procession of many small profile figures, horses, wheeled vehicles and a stylised tree — utterly different subject matter, composition and rendering conventions.
